turns.userText:
Repair and extend the SCAMP-Trie CPU pipeline in `/workspace/src`.
Make live prefix updates, compact memory snapshots, and reloaded lookup agree.
Support full 128-bit IPv6 longest prefix matching with

records.name: bash
records.summary:
cd /workspace && ls -la && find src -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p
' | sort && printf '
--- PROTOCOL ---
' && sed -n '1,260p' PROTOCOL.md

records.name: bash
records.summary:
cd /workspace && sed -n '1,240p' build.py && printf '
--- run.py ---
' && sed -n '1,300p' run.py && printf '
--- public_check.py ---
' && sed -n '1,320p' pu

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && for f in src/image.hpp src/image.cpp src/image_io.hpp src/main.cpp src/scamptrie_base.h src/scamptrie_base.cpp src/scamptrie_dynamic.h src/scam

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && for f in src/utils/*.h src/utils/*.cpp src/moo/moo_weights.h; do echo "===== $f ====="; sed -n '1,400p' "$f"; done

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && wc -l src/scamptrie_dynamic.cpp src/utils/mem_init.cpp && sed -n '300,760p' src/scamptrie_dynamic.cpp

records.name: bash
records.summary:
cd /workspace && cat examples/checks.json && printf '
--- instruction ---
' && cat instruction.md && printf '
--- files ---
' && find examples -type f -maxd

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && id && python3 --version && g++ --version | head -1 || true

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && grep -n "return bad();" src/image.cpp | wc -l && grep -n "return bad();" src/image.cpp | head

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat /tmp/genout.txt | head -3 && wc -c /tmp/builddebug.txt && grep -n "SCAMP_DEBUG_BUILD" src/image.cpp

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && head -5 /tmp/genout.txt && wc -c /tmp/builddebug.txt && SCAMP_DEBUG_BUILD=1 python3 /tmp/gen_repro.py 4 2>&1 | head -100

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i "73s/raise Bad('res')/raise Bad(f'res branch node={s},{c} type={typ} val={field(im,s,c,resoff,resw)}')/" /tmp/indep_validate.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find src -type f -printf '%p %s\n' | sort && printf 'entries=' && find src -mindepth 1 | wc -l && printf 'bytes=' && du -sb src | cut -f1

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && grep -R "^[[:space:]]*\(static \)\?MemInit\|new MemInit\|ScampTrieDynamic " -n src | head -20 && grep -R "printf\|cout" -n src/main.cpp src/ima

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -n '700,840p' src/image.cpp && sed -n '840,1130p' src/image.cpp | tail -120

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find src -type f -o -type d | while read p; do stat -c '%F %h %n' "$p"; done | sort | uniq -c | head -30
